items.sentence: CI runs 17 more files than before.
Release now also runs files in docker/ and site/public/atlas/.
Release runs 21 more files than before.
.github/ is now also read by packages/atlas/adapter/page.test.js.
And 320 more new writers and readers of places.
186 files added and 44 changed content, across 6 parts.

changesTogetherNote: 1 file changed together with its own test, as expected.
Window: 180 days; a pair counts from 10 shared commits, since 30 source files reach 10 revisions; the floor falls to 3 when fewer than 20 do.
derived: 23 parts, mostly JavaScript (958 files). Work enters through 15 doors; the busiest is Ingest dogfood submission, which reaches 7 parts and commits into the repository (Release reaches 12 but commits nothing). It publishes to npm and a container image. People run atlas, atlas-fleet, dogfood-init, dogfood-report, dogfood-verify, findings, portfolio, report and swarm.

doors.name: Release
sends: publishes to npm and a container image
triggers: when a tag matching `v*.*.*` is pushed

doors.name: CI
triggers: on a pull request touching 23 paths

doors.name: Ingest dogfood submission
triggers: when a repository sends a `dogfood_submission` event

doors.name: Deploy site to GitHub Pages
triggers: on a push to main touching 2 paths

doors.name: Atlas render
triggers: on a schedule (`0 6 * * 1`), Monday at 06:00 UTC

duplicatesLead: These are candidates from names and call order, not a judgement.
limits: 2 import sites name a declared dependency that shares its name with a local module (datasets); they are read as the dependency, which is not in this repository.
39 import sites could not be resolved.
3 import sites name a path outside this repository, so what they load is not followed.

9 files use syntax the parser cannot read (fixtures/atlas/languages/js/broken.js, fixtures/atlas/languages/py/broken.py, fixtures/atlas/languages/ts/broken.ts and 6 more), so what they import is not known: 8 in fixtures (a NUL character inside a string in 1 and other syntax in 7), 1 in schemas (a NUL character inside a string).
41 writes and 194 reads use paths built at run time and are not named here.
29 writes and 64 reads go to the directory the command is run in, the home directory or a path its caller passes, not to this repository.
310 commands are built at run time and not followed, 286 of them in tests.
Readers marked (found by text) come from scanning unparsed files.
Release runs or checks 561 files and directories; the map records 200 of them, some from every directory, and walks its reach from those.
CI runs or checks 557 files and directories; the map records 200 of them, some from every directory, and walks its reach from those.
